faqs.question: What is a Segmented Email Gateway?
faqs.answer: Think of it as a front desk for your email. Instead of giving everyone your real email address, you give out Duotail addresses made for a specific purpose — for example, one for online shopping (like user_shopping@). Every email sent to these addresses stops at our front desk first. We check whether the sender is someone you've allowed, and only then pass the email on to you.

faqs.question: How does Duotail differ from other email forwarding providers?
faqs.answer:
Most forwarding services simply pass every email along. Duotail is different in two important ways:
1. You decide who gets through: Only senders you've approved can reach you — everyone else is stopped before the email ever lands in your inbox. And you can still reply to any email you receive without revealing your real address.
2. We can't read your email: Many forwarding services can see the contents of your mail. With Duotail, your email is locked with a key that only you hold — it's created from your secret words, right in your own browser. We never have that key, so we simply cannot open your messages. Read our full Privacy Practices to learn more about how we protect you.

faqs.question: Is my personal email address exposed when using your service?
faqs.answer: Never. Your real email address is kept locked away. When you reply through Duotail, the other person only sees your Duotail address. We also remove hidden details that emails normally carry — such as your location and what device you're using — so nothing points back to you.

faqs.question: Do you store my emails?
faqs.answer: Yes, but only in a locked form that no one else can open — not us, and not anyone who asks us for it. We use the same well-proven security methods trusted by banks and governments. If you're curious about the technical details, see our Data Encryption Protocol. Stored emails are deleted automatically after 30 days, and you can delete them yourself at any time from your dashboard.

faqs.question: Why do you keep an encrypted copy of my mail?
faqs.answer:
Keeping a short-term, locked copy lets us offer two things regular email can't:
1. A helpful summary: We add a Smart Email Summary to each email you receive. It brings to light security details that are often hidden inside an email — such as tracking, the sender's real address behind their display name, and unsafe links — so you can see what you're dealing with at a glance. It also gives you one-click actions to change who can reach you, like unsubscribing from a sender.
2. The untouched original: Your email is yours. We keep the original, unchanged version of every email so you can download it whenever you need it.
These copies are kept for no more than 30 days.

faqs.question: Can I use this for standard, unrestricted email forwarding?
faqs.answer: No. Duotail is designed so that only the people and companies you approve can reach you. If a sender isn't on your approved list, their email is blocked. This keeps spam and junk mail from flooding your inbox.

faqs.question: What happens if I discontinue any of my Duotail email addresses?
faqs.answer: It stops working right away. Any email sent to that address is quietly thrown away. We deliberately don't tell the sender the address is gone — that way, spammers can't use the reply to figure out which addresses are real.

faqs.question: What happens to my information if Duotail stops its service?
faqs.answer: You'll never be left empty-handed. At any time, you can download your complete email profile from your account page. It includes far more than a list of contacts — it records every Duotail address you've created, what each one is for, and exactly who is allowed to reach you through it. Your profile is always available to download, so you can keep an up-to-date copy for your own records whenever you like.

faqs.question: Do I need to configure anything in my personal email account?
faqs.answer: No setup needed. Whether you use Gmail, Outlook, or another email provider, just tell Duotail where to send your mail and we take care of everything else — protecting your privacy and delivering your email automatically.
